sentences: A stream presents red and blue points on a planar grid, with equally many points of each color.
Their Earth Mover Distance is the minimum total cost of matching each red point to a blue point.
The source asks which approximation guarantees are possible when the stream can be retained only through a small memory state.
A central target is constant-factor approximation with space polynomial in the logarithms of the input and grid sizes.
Transportation structure must be captured without storing all points or the matching itself.
